landing.active_session_notice: You have an active ILIAS session.
landing.hero_badge: Open learning portal for University of Bern
landing.hero_tagline: The fast, customizable & modern learning portal
landing.hero_description: Built by students for students: 0ms load times with local caching, customizable courses, integrated podcast player, and fully responsive design for desktop, tablet, and mobile.
landing.highlights_subtitle: The key improvements over standard ILIAS at a glance.
landing.feature_cache_title: Lightning-fast load times with local caching
landing.feature_cache_desc: Standard ILIAS reloads an entire new HTML page for every single click, resulting in annoying blank white loading flashes and delays. BetterIlias caches overviews, materials, and structures locally in your browser and updates them silently in the background (SWR). Navigation feels like a native app – with zero white loading screens and 0ms load times.
landing.feature_cache_point1: Instant display of all courses and folders in 0ms
landing.feature_cache_point2: Smart SWR (Stale-While-Revalidate) keeps content consistently fresh
landing.feature_cache_point3: Offline-resilient: Already opened materials remain readable even without internet
landing.feature_custom_title: Design your semester according to your preferences
landing.feature_custom_desc: Put an end to confusing course codes. Assign custom nicknames, choose icons, organize the sidebar with drag & drop sections, and customize accent colors.
landing.feature_custom_point1: Custom nicknames & icons for every course
landing.feature_custom_point3: Full Dark Mode and customizable accent colors
landing.feature_calendar_desc: The built-in calendar extracts lecture times automatically from ILIAS. Featuring custom course colors, week and month views, conflict detection, and ICS export.
landing.feature_calendar_point1: Automatic extraction of lecture times from courses
landing.feature_calendar_point2: Custom lecture & exercise times: Add individual slots for exercise groups, tutorials, or courses without fixed ILIAS schedules
landing.feature_calendar_point3: Schedule conflict detection and customizable rule overrides
landing.feature_exercises_desc: Whether as a student or TA: managing submissions has never been easier. Clear deadlines, multi-file uploads, automatic work distribution across TAs, and ZIP mass exports.
landing.feature_exercises_point1: Compact submission and feedback overview with status display
landing.feature_exercises_point2: Distribute workload among TAs with a few clicks
landing.feature_exercises_point3: Direct ZIP export for individual TAs or all submissions
landing.ta_grading_toolbar: TA grading tools with quick filters
landing.feature_video_desc: Play lecture recordings directly in the portal. With timeline preview, flexible speeds, autoplay, and remembered playback positions.
landing.feature_video_point1: Timeline thumbnail preview on scrub bar hover
landing.feature_video_point2: Speed control (0.75x to 2x) and keyboard navigation
landing.feature_video_point3: Remembers exact playback position for every recording
landing.feature_structures_title: Support for all ILIAS content & LaTeX
landing.feature_structures_desc: BetterIlias supports the full ILIAS repository: folder hierarchies, files, forums, learning modules, and styled LaTeX/MathJax rendering for mathematical and scientific formulas.
landing.feature_structures_point1: Seamless navigation through repository and nested folders
landing.feature_structures_point2: First-class rendering for mathematical LaTeX formulas
landing.feature_structures_point3: Integrated document preview and direct downloads
landing.extension_desc: No tedious password typing or cookie copying. The extension for Chrome and Firefox detects your SWITCH edu-ID login and synchronizes your session with a single click.
landing.extension_point2: QR code handoff for smartphones and tablets
landing.extension_point3: Automatic detection of active ILIAS tabs
landing.extension_box_desc: Simply install in your browser and get started instantly.
landing.comparison_subtitle: Standard ILIAS vs. BetterIlias at a glance
landing.comp_speed_standard: Page reload on every click (blank white screens)
landing.comp_speed_better: 0ms instant navigation without page reload (local cache + SWR)
landing.comp_theme_standard: Rigid layout, cryptic course codes, no dark mode
landing.comp_theme_better: Fully customizable (nicknames, icons, sections), dark & light mode, accent colors
landing.comp_calendar_better: Interactive color calendar with custom times & ICS export
landing.comp_video_standard: Preview and progress supported, but clunky controls and buggy keyboard navigation
landing.comp_video_better: Smooth timeline preview, reliable progress memory, and intuitive keyboard navigation
landing.comp_ta_standard: Not supported by ILIAS (no tutor distribution available)
landing.comp_ta_better: Automatic, fair distribution among TAs, assignment filters & individual ZIP export
landing.bottom_cta_title: Ready for a better ILIAS experience?
landing.bottom_cta_desc: Start directly in your browser – no installation or registration required.
landing.feature_structures_note: BetterIlias is under active development. Repository and folder navigation, assignments, podcasts, and downloads are fully functional. Additional ILIAS objects such as interactive learning modules and tests are currently in progress and will follow in upcoming updates.
landing.feature_mobile_desc: Standard ILIAS on a phone means tiny click targets and unreadable tables. BetterIlias is optimized for mobile devices: responsive cards, comfortable touch controls (at least 44x44px), clean mobile course views, and smooth gestures.
landing.feature_mobile_point1: Responsive smartphone and tablet layouts for all views
landing.feature_mobile_point2: Touch-optimized controls without horizontal scrolling chaos
landing.feature_mobile_point3: Simple session sharing via QR code from desktop to smartphone
landing.extension_store_note: Open source on GitHub. Chrome & Firefox store releases in preparation.
landing.comp_mobile_standard: Unoptimized desktop tables, hard to use on phones
landing.comp_mobile_better: Mobile-friendly with touch layouts & QR handoff
landing.quickstart_desc: Connect your ILIAS account to BetterIlias in less than two minutes.
landing.step1_desc: Download the BetterIlias extension for Chrome or Firefox.
landing.step2_desc: Log in as usual on ilias.unibe.ch with your SWITCH edu-ID.
landing.step3_desc: The extension synchronizes your ILIAS session automatically upon opening. If needed, you can manually sync at any time via the extension icon.
landing.step4_desc: Open the app and navigate your semester with lightning speed and custom styling!

legal.modal_subtitle: Legal information & data privacy for BetterIlias
legal.operator_heading: Information according to § 5 DDG & Art. 3 para. 1 lit. s UWG
legal.operator_desc: BetterIlias is an open-source student project to improve the usability and performance of ILIAS at the University of Bern.
legal.disclaimer_desc: BetterIlias is an independent third-party client. There is no organizational, legal, or commercial affiliation with the University of Bern or SWITCH. All trademark rights, names, and logos remain with their respective owners.
legal.liability_desc: The contents of this application are created with the utmost care. No guarantee is assumed for the accuracy, completeness, or timeliness of data retrieved from ILIAS. Operators of linked external websites are solely responsible for their content.
legal.license_desc: The BetterIlias source code is openly available on GitHub under the MIT License. All lecture materials, PDFs, and videos remain the property of their respective creators and are passed through solely for authenticated students and staff.
legal.privacy_overview_desc: BetterIlias collects no user profiles, uses no Google Analytics, no advertising trackers, and stores no passwords on the server. All requests to ILIAS occur strictly on behalf and using the active session of the user.
legal.privacy_controller_desc: The BetterIlias project is the controller responsible for data processing under the Swiss Data Protection Act (revDSG) and the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) (Email: manuel@betterilias.ch).
legal.privacy_data_desc: The following data categories are processed strictly for service provision:
legal.privacy_data_point1: Session Data (.sessions): Session cookies (such as PHPSESSID) are stored temporarily and isolated on the server solely to authenticate with ilias.unibe.ch. They are deleted automatically upon logout or expiry.
legal.privacy_data_point2: Local Storage (localStorage): Your lecture nicknames, timetable colors, custom sorting, and view cache are stored exclusively inside your browser.
legal.privacy_data_point3: Operational logs: Fixed event codes, timestamps and random technical correlation identifiers help maintain and protect the service. Registered route templates, parser names, software version, fixed failure categories and code-only file/function/line locations help diagnose errors. No actual URLs, IP addresses, names, student IDs, grades, raw pages, exception text or local variables are included. Access is restricted to maintainers; configured retention is at most 30 days, with earlier removal under storage pressure. These technical records should not be treated as guaranteed anonymous data.
legal.privacy_data_point4: Connection activity: To measure recent service usage, the server keeps minute samples with a secret-derived pseudonymous connection key and a last-seen timestamp. No raw session credential, IP address or account name is stored in these samples. Administrators see aggregate counts only. App refreshes count as activity. Samples expire after 24 hours and are removed on access and scheduled maintenance. This operational measurement is separate from optional error-report consent.
legal.privacy_data_point5: Optional error reports: You can decline, share once or enable automatic sharing, and change this choice or delete your shared reports in settings. Reports contain technical metadata and, where available, text-free page outlines. A private draft can be held for up to 10 minutes before your choice. Maintainers receive shared reports for at most 30 days, including resolved reports; storage limits may remove them earlier. Sharing preferences expire after at most 90 days and are scoped to your current connection.
legal.privacy_cookies_desc: BetterIlias uses session cookies for service operation and a separate browser cookie lasting up to one year for community votes and editing access. Settings and an optional nickname are stored locally in your browser. No tracking, analytics, or third-party advertising cookies are used.
legal.privacy_security_desc: The server is hosted in an ISO 27001-certified data center in Germany (EU). Switzerland and the EU have mutual adequacy decisions regarding data protection. All transmission is encrypted end-to-end via TLS 1.3.
legal.privacy_rights_heading: 5. Your Rights as a Data Subject
legal.privacy_rights_desc: You have the right at any time to access, rectify, or erase your personal data, as well as the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (e.g. FDPIC in Switzerland or German state data protection authorities).
legal.jurisdiction_notice: BetterIlias complies with the Swiss Data Protection Act (revDSG) and the EU GDPR.
landing.footer_disclaimer: BetterIlias is an independent open-source project and is not officially affiliated with the University of Bern or SWITCH.
